title: Constraints
description: Enforcing data integrity with table constraints including CHECK, FOREIGN KEY, NOT NULL, and UNIQUE.
longDescription: This module covers table constraints in SQL Server. You'll learn how to enforce data integrity using CHECK constraints for value validation, FOREIGN KEY constraints for referential integrity, NOT NULL constraints to prevent null values, and UNIQUE constraints to ensure uniqueness across rows.
whatYouLearn: Use CHECK constraints to enforce domain integrity and validate column values
Use FOREIGN KEY constraints to enforce referential integrity between tables
Use NOT NULL constraints to prevent NULL values in columns
Use UNIQUE constraints to ensure uniqueness of data across rows
